pattern_explanation: These Turkish words look like English words because both languages borrowed them from the same source, but over time the Turkish forms took on meanings that differ from their English look-alikes.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word pasta looks like the English word pasta, but in Turkish it means cake, while English pasta refers to noodles. The Turkish word sempatik sounds like the English word sympathetic but means nice or likeable, not showing sympathy.
